verdict.rationale: Asking whether a payments platform's source is available under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions source availability, a source repository, or any open-source license for SumUp or its SDKs. The @sumup/sdk package, MCP server and plain-text docs show developer tooling and doc openness, not open-licensed source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
